body:
Merge-time refresh: main is merged into this branch (merge commit 244635103). The new head is 0c477509a.

Hunks that we resolved by hand (we kept both sides in each):

- `crates/app/src/posting.rs`, `MACHINES` list: the list keeps the entries from main and the "Sinker EDM 3-axis (template)" entry.
- `crates/app/tests/machine.rs`, expectations: the table keeps the rows from main and the row from this PR.
- `crates/app/src/posting.rs`, the "declared, never inferred" check: the check is now the union `Plasma | SinkerEdm | WireEdm`.

New commit 0c477509a, `fix(ui): ribbon mode row for the sinker EDM template`:

- Main (issue 1501) added the `MACHINE_MODES` table and a guard test. The guard test makes sure that each machine kind in the built-in library has a ribbon mode row. This PR is the first to ship a `SinkerEdm` machine, so the guard test failed after the merge.
- The commit adds a "Sinker EDM" row. The row mounts "Sinker EDM 3-axis (template)" with the same undoable `LoadBuiltinMachine` as the other rows. The door word is "Sinker". The guard test did not change.
- The `short_caption` wildcard arm is removed, because each kind now has an arm.
- The template post still refuses by name until the user fills in `edm.codes`. The test `sinker_burn::the_shipped_sinker_template_lists_and_refuses_its_unfilled_codes_by_name` pins this refusal.
- `machine_mode_tests` has a new test for the sinker row. `tips_match_the_imgui_table` has the new door tip.
- The decision is in `docs/decisions/1135-sinker-template-library.md`.

Tests and clippy on 0c477509a (Windows, debug):

- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`): 816 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test machine --test sinker_burn --test machine_library --test edm_machine --test post_serves_kind`: 33, 15, 11, 5 and 6 passed, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --tests -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --tests -- -D warnings`: clean.

Not run: the integration suites in `crates/ui/tests/`, the ignored pixel-snapshot lanes, and the full app suite (the merge-time run before this commit covered the app suites that the merge touched). No snapshot PNG changed.

The ribbon screenshots are in the PR body (section "Screenshots"): before and after, at 1280 px and 1920 px. The Machines pane and the library list view are still owed. The headless render shows the ribbon only.
